summary: BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K to report that it received a notice from Nasdaq on April 21, 2026 confirming regained compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). The company issued a press release announcing strengthened balance sheet and capital runway into late 2027. This is a routine compliance update, not a special-situation event; the filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The sole action is a regulatory compliance notification. There are no deal terms or transactional mechanics to analyze.
